summary: The Collective and Atari's graffiti-focused action-adventure, later re-released on Steam.

entries.title: Marc Ecko's Getting Up: Contents Under Pressure

emulation.notes: Use Windows/Steam for the main route; emulate PS2/Xbox only for original-platform comparison.

primary.why: Getting Up released for PlayStation 2, Windows, Xbox, and mobile phone, with the Steam re-release developed by General Arcade and published by Devolver Digital. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most accessible modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows/Steam version natively; use console or mobile versions only for preservation comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release with later Steam re-release.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most accessible modern route.
skip: original route but lower practical fidelity than Windows.
skip: original console route but no sourced content advantage over Windows.
skip: mobile preservation route and no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary route; Windows/Steam is the modern access route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Steam release is a re-release, not a full remaster.
